title: Season 1 — Omnilia (Clarity Arc)
premise: Clarity Incorporated controls Neo Terra from the shadows. Claire Atropos runs the Beast Conversion Program, abducting metahumans and turning them into animal-themed servants. Vaiva Petrauskaitė, the newly active Colorgarde, decides to bring the corporation down — while Claire treats the whole campaign as a delicious game.
toneNotes: Cyberpunk comic-book melodrama. Villainesses are seductive, theatrical, and usually winning; heroes are earnest and outmatched. Violence and erotic villainy are genre-normal but never grimdark for its own sake.

goals: Convert every useful metahuman through the Beast Conversion Program
Give Colorgarde the resources to dismantle Clarity

threats.name: Clarity Incorporated
threats.agenda: Complete the Beast Conversion Program, break the hero community, and rule Neo Terra as a corporate fiefdom.
stages: Infiltration and blackmail of city institutions
BCP abductions and the first converted heroes
Open control of the police and the media
Total conversion of the hero community

threats.name: The Beast Conversion Program
threats.agenda: Perfect the gene-splicing and conditioning process that turns captured metahumans into obedient animal-themed servants.

canonBeats.title: The Illegal Arms Deal
canonBeats.description: Colorgarde interrupts one of Clarity's illegal arms deals, announcing herself as a real threat to the corporation.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: Clarity ships the weapons unimpeded and gains a free escalation toward city control.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: Any public Clarity operation interrupted by Colorgarde counts. If Vaiva is not present, another hero or a vigilante may crash the deal instead.

canonBeats.title: Rumors of the Beast Conversion Program
canonBeats.description: The first credible rumor surfaces that missing metahumans are being experimented on rather than killed.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: The BCP stays entirely off the heroes' radar and converts a named hero off-screen as escalation.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: The rumor may come from a victim, a defecting Clarity scientist, or a police file. The source does not matter; the reveal does.

canonBeats.title: The First Conversion
canonBeats.description: A known metahuman is broken by the BCP and reappears as an animal-themed villain serving Clarity.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: Clarity converts a different hero instead; the hero community loses a named ally and the threat advances a stage.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: Any roster hero may replace Aurelia as the first conversion. Record adaptedFrom/adaptedTo and keep the converted character's relationships.

canonBeats.title: Crystal Cat Hunts Colorgarde
canonBeats.description: Mira Shard, Claire's crystal clone, is deployed specifically to neutralize Colorgarde's light powers and humiliate her in public.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: Mira captures an ally instead, and Claire gains leverage over Colorgarde.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: The function is a tailored counter to the protagonist. If Mira is gone, Claire builds or hires a different counter.

canonBeats.title: The Confrontation with Claire
canonBeats.description: Colorgarde and Claire Atropos finally face each other with the fate of the city on the line.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: Claire completes her endgame uncontested; the season moves to villain victory unless a later beat intervenes.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: The confrontation can happen anywhere Claire's plans converge. Substitutes may take Claire's place only if she is already defeated; then this beat short-circuits.

canonBeats.title: Clarity Incorporated Falls
canonBeats.description: Claire is defeated and Clarity's control breaks — through capture, conversion, death, or a public collapse of the corporation.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: The final deadline passes: Claire wins completely, and the season ends in a recorded villain victory.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: Claire may be brainwashed into Claire Lachesis, imprisoned, killed, or forced into exile. Any terminal or converted state resolves the beat; record the divergence.

canonBeats.title: A Favor at the Docks
canonBeats.description: A dockworker asks Colorgarde for a small, human favor: escort a witness past a Clarity checkpoint, or find a missing brother before the conversion vans do.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: Optional: the docks remember that Colorgarde never came.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: Any small civilian request near the docks counts. The favor may be refused without consequence.

canonBeats.title: A Night at the Shelter
canonBeats.description: The Petrabyte safehouse is short-handed. Spend a night helping the people Clarity has already hurt, and hear what they know.
canonBeats.deadlineConsequence: Optional: the safehouse manages without you, and the city keeps its distance.
canonBeats.rewriteHints: Any safehouse, clinic, or civilian shelter works. This is a civilian-life beat, not a canon obligation.

epilogue.title: After the Colorgarde
paragraphs: {{victor}} owns Neo Terra now. {{location}} is the seat of the new order, and the Beast Conversion Program no longer needs to hide behind procurement contracts.
The city remembers the weeks when Colorgarde was still possible. {{faction}} holds the streets it can, and the rest of the districts have learned which checkpoints to avoid after dark.

{{player}} is left standing at the edge of a city that has made its choice. The season is over; what remains is the question of whether the next one begins with surrender, resistance, or something quieter.

threat.name: The Clarity Mandate
threat.agenda: Convert or erase every remaining metahuman, and make the Colorgarde name a warning.

beats.title: Find the First Ally
beats.description: Reach the people Clarity has not converted yet: a dockworker, a defector, a hero in hiding. One ally is enough to begin.
beats.deadlineConsequence: The victor captures a prospective ally and the cell shrinks.
beats.rewriteHints: Any ally, defector, or contact may anchor the cell.

beats.title: Break the Conversion Ledger
beats.description: Hit the Clarity facility that records every conversion, and prove the program can lose its paperwork.
beats.deadlineConsequence: The regime tightens control and the resistance loses its base.
beats.rewriteHints: The target may be a symbol, a prison, or a supply hub.

threat.name: The Colorgarde Remnant
threat.agenda: Keep the old hero network alive and make the Mandate bleed for every district.

beats.title: Audit a Loyalty File
beats.description: Review a converted servant's file for a flaw the Mandate missed, and decide whether to expose or exploit it.
beats.deadlineConsequence: The resistance recruits a named hero and gains influence.
beats.rewriteHints: Any cell, safehouse, or symbol of resistance counts.

beats.title: Secure the Waterfront
beats.description: Take the docks for the Mandate and cut the remnant off from its last open supply route.
beats.deadlineConsequence: The resistance holds the district and humiliates the victor.
beats.rewriteHints: Use an occupied district; the exact target may change.

conquest.goal: Conquer the neighbouring districts and city.
